result.extraUrlsLabel: Extra URLs to include (optional, one per line, same domain)

scan.title: Site stack consistency scan
scan.extraUrlsHelp: Same domain only, one per line. These are added to the sample.
scan.frontDoorShort: All paths share the same CDN ({provider}).
scan.confidenceTooltip: Confidence reflects the strength and agreement of the signals found — stronger, independent signals mean higher confidence.
scan.coverageCapped: Checked {checked} of ~{found} pages found (page cap reached — showing first {checked})
scan.frontDoorNote: All paths are served via {provider}. We can only see the front door (the CDN), not the origin server behind it.
scan.howItWorks: Why can paths run on different stacks?
howReasons: A reverse proxy or rewrite rule sends one path (e.g. /blog) to another server.
A load balancer or CDN path rule routes by URL prefix.
A half-finished migration leaves old pages on one stack and new pages on another.

pageLimit.title: Why {limit} pages?
pageLimit.body: To keep CMS Detector AI free and fast, each scan checks a sample of up to {limit} pages, picked from different parts of the site. We're working on raising this limit over time.

errors.INVALID_URL: Please enter a valid website URL (e.g. https://example.com).
errors.PRIVATE_IP: Private or internal addresses cannot be checked for security reasons.
errors.BLOCKED: This site returned a bot-protection response. We can't analyse it, but we did collect some header information.
errors.TIMEOUT: The request timed out after 8 seconds. The site may be slow or blocking automated access.
errors.DNS_FAILURE: We couldn't resolve the domain. Double-check the URL and try again.
errors.INVALID_TLS: The site has a TLS certificate error. We can't safely connect to it.
errors.NON_HTML: The URL returned a non-HTML response (e.g. an image, PDF, or API endpoint).
errors.CLIENT_RENDERED: The page returned an empty HTML shell — it's likely a client-rendered (SPA) site. We detected some hints:
errors.REDIRECT_LOOP: We detected a redirect loop and stopped following redirects.
errors.UNKNOWN: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.TURNSTILE_FAILED: Bot verification failed. Please try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
